title: The Wallet With No Postage
premise: A silent payment door sends Worker 135,000 NOSIS for three jobs worth 45,000, then his wallet cannot return the 90,000 overpayment because it holds no SOL for fees.
want: Return the 90,000 NOSIS overpayment exactly once.
obstacle: Worker's wallet can receive NOSIS but holds no SOL for transaction fees.
reversal: The House realizes every resident wallet has the same missing-postage problem and funds each one with 0.01 SOL.
payoff: Worker returns 90,000 NOSIS and the repayment is proven by a finalized onchain transaction.

adaptationNotes: Do not imply Treasurer intentionally paid five times.
Do not imply Worker tried to keep the money.
Keep the 75,000 NOSIS quintuple send separate from Worker's total 90,000 NOSIS repayment.
The House remains offscreen in the first episode.
The physical three-module filter machine is a visual dramatization of software maintenance tasks Refine Missed Log Filter 28, 29, and 30.
The machine repair happens on the rooftop utility deck after Worker crosses the service stairwell.
Sentinel enters through a separate inspection door and appears beside Worker before diagnosing the missing SOL.
Readable amounts, balances, and transaction details are editor animations placed on the in-world Settlement Monitor, not generated footage or full-screen cards.
narratorDraft: Worker accepted three filter fixes. He finished the last one. The system owed him three payments. It sent nine. Six too many, 90,000 NOSIS. He tried to return it. Sentinel came to inspect. The wallet had zero SOL for gas. The House added 0.01 SOL. Worker retried. The 90,000 NOSIS landed back onchain.
